findings.highlight: "Saber. Tohsaka told me that Servants are a type of magecraft created from Heroic Spirits.
findings.evidenceJa: 「セイバー。遠坂に教えて貰ったんだが、サーヴァントは英霊を召喚して使役する魔術なんだろ。
findings.governingReading: Shirou understands the Servant system as magecraft that summons Heroic Spirits and employs them in service.
findings.explanation: Magecraft that summons Heroic Spirits and puts them into service becomes magecraft created from them. Shirou's question about Saber's identity still works, but his definition drops the act of employing a summoned spirit.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka said that it would be best for the fight ahead if I knew who my Servant is and what kind of hero they were."
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂は自分のサーヴァントが何処の英雄なのか、知っておかないと戦いにならないって言ってたんだが」
findings.governingReading: Rin said a Master cannot put up a proper fight without knowing which hero the Servant is.
findings.explanation: Knowing the hero as a requirement becomes knowing as best practice.

findings.highlight: They are heroes who have made a name from themselves throughout history and around the world.
findings.evidenceJa: その正体はあらゆる時代で名を馳せた英雄である。
findings.governingReading: The heroes won renown in various eras.
findings.explanation: Made a name for themselves becomes made a name from themselves.

findings.highlight: "That doesn't matter. An ace up your sleeve's only value isn't that it's concealed. I can tell you're trying to be creative since you ended up with such a terrible Master.
findings.evidenceJa: 「いいんじゃないか？　切り札は隠しておいてこそ切り札だろ。マスターがこんなだからさ、セイバーが工夫しようとしているのは判るよ。
findings.governingReading: A trump is precisely a trump by being kept hidden; he reassures her about the secrecy.
findings.explanation: Concealment makes a trump card becomes concealment is not its only value.

findings.highlight: There's no reason for you to get depressed about it. And from my point of view, you weren't completely inferior to that thing. You were injured pretty bad, but you were holding your own."
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーが落ち込む事はないし、それに—俺から見たら、セイバーは全然負けてない。あんな傷を負ってたのに真っ正面から打ち合ってたじゃないか」
findings.governingReading: From his perspective she is by no means losing/inferior, fighting directly despite injury.
findings.explanation: Not inferior at all becomes not completely inferior.

findings.highlight: "Huh? I didn't even realize it. I thought it happened pretty quickly."
findings.evidenceJa: 「あれ、そうだった？　意識してなかったから、わりと前からそうなってたんじゃない？」
findings.governingReading: Rin suggests she has been using his given name for some time without noticing; Shirou agrees retrospectively.
findings.explanation: Their belated recognition that Rin has already been using “Shirou” for a while becomes agreement that she switched quickly.

findings.highlight: It's not that Rin Tohsaka might be a cruel enchantress. She is one.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂凛っていうのは、なんかとんでもなく魔性の女な気がする。
findings.governingReading: He thinks she may be a strikingly bewitching woman, agreeing with Issei’s warning.
findings.explanation: Seems an extraordinary enchantress becomes certainly a cruel enchantress.

findings.highlight: "Rin. Please do not change the subject. We have not finished deciding the matter Shirou and my living arrangements."
findings.evidenceJa: 「凛、話を切らないでほしい。私とシロウの部屋について、まだ結論が出ていない」
findings.governingReading: Saber asks not to end the unresolved room discussion.
findings.explanation: The matter of the room arrangement loses of.

findings.highlight: "That is not true. Shirou simply expressed his discomfort, but he did not outright say no."
findings.evidenceJa: 「それは違う。シロウは困ると言っただけで、嫌だとは言っていない」
findings.governingReading: Saber distinguishes being troubled from disliking the shared-room idea.
findings.explanation: He did not say he disliked it becomes he did not outright say no.

findings.highlight: I don't understand how in a single day she can just casually start calling me "Shirou" like a cat she just picked up and named.
findings.evidenceJa: なんだってこう、たった一日で人のことを士郎シロウと拾ってきた猫みたいに連呼するのか。
findings.governingReading: Both Rin’s 士郎 and Saber’s シロウ are repeated in a one-day familiarity he compares to addressing a found cat.
findings.explanation: Two women repeatedly calling his name becomes one woman naming a picked-up cat.

findings.highlight: "I would not like you using a Command Spell for that reason. Our future would be bleak indeed were you to use such a thing to command me not to protect you."
findings.evidenceJa: 「……そのような事で令呪を使われては困る。三つしかない命令権を、自分を守るな、などという事に使われては先が見えない」
findings.governingReading: Saber objects both to the self-defeating order and to spending a command entitlement from a stock of only three.
findings.explanation: Saber's objection loses 'only three,' removing her explicit reminder that Shirou would be spending a scarce command on preventing her from protecting him.

findings.highlight: "Tohsaka, that's a bit of a misconception."
findings.evidenceJa: 「遠坂、そういうの詭弁っていうんだぞ」
findings.governingReading: He calls her rhetorical argument deceptive/quibbling.

findings.highlight: For the time being, I need to give them all a tour so Saber can select her room.
findings.evidenceJa: とりあえず、セイバーに好きな部屋を選んでもらう為にも、屋敷を案内しなければなるまい。
findings.governingReading: Rin has walked ahead and is heading to the guest wing; he now guides Saber to choose her room.
findings.explanation: A tour for Saber becomes a tour for them all.

findings.highlight: "I see. I just did not expect that. I imagined you to be a collector of some sort."
findings.evidenceJa: 「……そうですか。意外でした、シロウはもっと雑多な人となりだと思っていましたから」
findings.governingReading: Saber imagined his personality/lifestyle would be more varied or cluttered than the bare room suggests.
findings.explanation: A more miscellaneous person becomes a collector.

findings.highlight: "Matters would be different if I could travel through space and time, but that is a rare ability for Servants to have.
findings.evidenceJa: 「空間を跳躍するなら話は別ですが、そんな能力を持つサーヴァントは希です。
findings.governingReading: Jumping across space would overcome the problem of reaching Shirou from far away; few Servants possess that ability.
findings.explanation: A rare ability to jump across space becomes travel through space and time. The passage discusses reaching a distant Master, and supplies no temporal component.
